svg.title: Selection happens before the model sees a document.

cc:Work.dc:title: Selection happens before the model sees a document.
cc:Work.dc:description: 156 records · languages: eng=156 · 52 neural inputs exceed 256 wordpieces Source: three capped Europe PMC API queries plus six explicit anchors. Missing abstracts and withheld abstracts are different states. The query filters FIRST_PDATE; the chart displays pubYear. Online-first and issue years can differ. The corpus is not a systematic review.
